name: Kounen Ichibee
source:
The monk who has gone the path of asura (destruction). He is a member of the Dominion 17th team and has a straight, honest personality as long as he gets his fight.
His youkai ancestry stems from a youkai species called [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gashadokuro]Gashadokuro[/url] (giant skeletons, the spirits of the unburied dead). His power is to realize the swordsmen he defeated in the past and thus controlling many sword at once…up to 30.

[Edited from a really spoiler-filled [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2010/12/12/chronobelt-review]Chrono Belt review[/url] by Warum]
